relaxedConditions: Nonzero commands no longer veto physical measurements
PV changes over 100 W are corrected rather than blindly rejected
Connected EV with fresh idle-current feedback is allowed
An isolated outlier or missed P1 point is tolerated
Completed windows tolerate bounded scheduler jitter without delaying commands

measurement.houseLoadFormula: P1 import + measured PV production + measured battery power; discharge positive, charge negative
measurement.batterySource: Existing Report external EMS battery power Flow; MUST contain current actual TOTAL physical battery power, never a requested setpoint
measurement.baseline: median and MAD of recent corrected residuals, or existing idle battery-free reference buckets
measurement.modulationLimit: robust sigma <= max(250 W, 60% signal); early/late drift <= max(300 W, 60% signal)
measurement.confidence: 3 independent estimates within max(50 W, 25% cluster median); at most 5 evidence records per mode
measurement.retry: Existing evaluations prepare a new reference; a real attributable HVAC step starts a new attempt, never a P1 update
measurement.activeBoiler: Rejected: no existing actual boiler power meter can safely correct it

widget: Received device mode determines ON/OFF and heat/cool display over old commands, including when EMS control is off; existing 10 s refresh retained

validation.visualChecks: DOM rendering and assertions only; no real desktop/mobile theme inspection

hostWorstCaseMemoryProbe.environment: Node 22 host; isolated real learner structures, 1000 models; GC before/after; excludes SDK storage implementation

limitations: No physical Homey or HVAC measurements
No visual inspection on a real desktop/phone or light/dark browser; DOM rendering checked
Underlying sensor age before the existing Flow receipt cannot be verified; feed genuine current measured aggregate battery power
Unchanged independent battery/EV/boiler/AutoTune/Hybrid/PV engines did not receive a full regression run; directly touched feedback/cache/Hybrid paths were tested
